entities.summary: Camilo Ugo Carabelli is an Argentine professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 43 achieved on 18 August 2025 and a best doubles ranking of No. 190 reached on 30 March 2026. He is currently the No. 4 Argentine player.
